plan_title: SSPLAN-707 Test Plan — Load DSP data into Sales Planning marts

results.test: Primary Load DSP data into Sales Planning marts render path
results.steps: Open target route with valid fixture/user context.
results.assertion: Expected primary content appears with correct title/value labels and no console/runtime error.
results.evidence: The DSP/metrics architecture described by the plan is not present in this project. Backend code exposes only `/api` GET routes (backend/src/main/java/com/ikea/sp/controller/DashboardController.java:14,29-145), uses mock H2 seed data instead of DSP marts (backend/src/main/resources/data.sql:31-38; backend/src/main/java/com/ikea/sp/service/impl/H2PerformanceService.java:55-62,71-101), and contains no `/metrics` POST controller, dispatcher, or typed metric request classes.
